title: Noname NDE 1100
content:
It's difficult to describe, it was difficult for me to find the right words. First thing was an unfathomable black and the feeling of an out of body experience. Then the light, everywhere, not dazzling, neither hot nor cold, like being bathed in love. I saw my all life story, but when they send me back to earth (or maybe I decided on my own to come back) they erased all that I saw (probably to not modify my destiny in any way?). Anyway, after my come back (additionally very difficult) I kept some memories in mind about my trip in the other side. There is also the concept of time. Time doesn't exist either. The absence of fear - all the time, I was fearless; from that time I knew I would die and up to now. And there was also the 'music'.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death Motorbike accident, internal bleeding.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning No more time, no more three dimensional space, impression of being able 'to move' without any effort or movement.
elements.The experience included: Void | Darkness | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Vision of the future | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes A light not dazzling, not hot nor cold.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I saw all my life from the beginning up to the end.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The fear of not being understood, difficult to describe with words.
